headline: Conquistadors: Preseason Front Office Brief
executive_summary: Conquistadors is projected #2 of 16 with a 726.40 projected-starting-lineup C-AVI total, led by Josh Allen, Puka Nacua, and Bijan Robinson. The immediate priority is improving the FLEX slot without weakening that core.
